description: Animated QR sequences (WIRE-175..177): frames FS1A:<seq>/<total>:<message-id>:<payload> for objects of the stated size, built from SHA-256("fieldseal.dev/vectors/qr/<id>/<n>") streams; the receiver's results for loops in other orders and for damaged or conflicting frames. In a result, `at_frame` is the index of the frame that completed the object or failed.
